source_type_decision.reason: Both source rows ask the same concrete zero-downtime production migration from 16 tables to 64 tables. The candidate therefore needs an executable migration design with scale assumptions, data-flow and cutover states, consistency and rollback boundaries, failure recovery, verification and rollout tradeoffs rather than generic sharding theory.

primary_sources_checked.title: Debezium Documentation: Connector for MySQL
verified_claims: the connector performs an initial consistent snapshot, uses repeatable-read snapshot semantics, records the current binlog position, and after the snapshot streams from that position
connector/task restart can regenerate already processed events, so downstream processing must tolerate duplicates
if the required binlog position has been purged, the old streaming position cannot simply be resumed and a new snapshot/baseline may be required

primary_sources_checked.title: MySQL 8.4 Reference Manual: Introduction to InnoDB
verified_claims: InnoDB DML follows the ACID model with commit, rollback and crash-recovery capabilities

primary_sources_checked.title: MySQL 8.4 Reference Manual: InnoDB and Online DDL
verified_claims: ALTER TABLE ALGORITHM and LOCK clauses control the requested online-DDL behavior
LOCK=NONE is used when reads and writes must remain permitted and an unsupported requested concurrency level does not silently become a universal lock-free guarantee

primary_sources_checked.title: MySQL 8.4 Reference Manual: Online DDL Operations
verified_claims: online-DDL support is operation-dependent: some operations permit concurrent DML while others rebuild/copy data or do not permit the same concurrency
INSTANT is the default algorithm in MySQL 8.4 when the operation supports it, which still does not make every DDL operation instant or lock-free

next_required_action: Bind the verified claims to an answer_evidence sidecar and run the deterministic candidate audit with --require-evidence. If that passes, obtain the mandatory pilot human approval before atomic promotion. Do not fabricate human review or promotion state.
